name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: WDUi Framework SDK 0.1.3: Direct2D performance update pro rychlejsi interakci. Native DC render target se cachuje na okno, full repaint pouziva CLEAR init, hover/wheel/scroll/menu/list/select/text controly invaliduji lokalni viewporty misto celeho okna a smoke test hlida, ze hover dirty rect zustava maly a opakovany Direct2D repaint nevytvari novy DC target.
changes_en: WDUi Framework SDK 0.1.3: Direct2D performance update for faster interaction. The native DC render target is cached per window, full repaint uses CLEAR initialization, hover/wheel/scroll/menu/list/select/text controls invalidate local viewports instead of the whole window, and smoke tests verify small hover dirty rects plus no repeated Direct2D DC target creation.
